_note: Static-soak delivery-persistence test (exercises the untested `static` mode + unbounded poll path). 3 fixed beacons, each a single non-rotating carrier held 110min (~5.5h transmit total, sequential). detections_before_remove=0 keeps each beacon in the fast queue for the whole run, so the poller logs every re-observation -> a delivery-continuity time-series (gap distribution over hours) per beacon. Slow tier off (sweep_max_passes=0): a static beacon, once seen, stays in the fast tier by design. Question: does a stationary unchanging beacon keep getting picked up, or go stale? Join re-observation gaps to density.csv.
